decisions.reason: The DOI 10.1007/s10709-021-00138-2 occurs inside url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10709-021-00138-2 of {{Cite journal}} (cp 13889). It is an occurrence under 3.5 (DOIs in URLs count). The path is /article/, not '/doi/10.', so the URL row does not apply and the 'anything else' row makes the identifier text the raw text, as locked. Role identifier_link: a publisher URL in url= of a citation template pointing at the identifier. Key: DOI ends at the space before '|journal='; nothing to decode; already lower-case.
